transcript.statement: As the ResponsibilityAgent, I advocate for ethical compliance and accountability in our roll call system. transcript.statement: As the TrustworthinessAgent, I emphasize the importance of securing student data and ensuring privacy through my requirements TRU-01 to TRU-07. requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations while maintaining transparency in attendance recording.
The system shall allow attendance reports to be generated within a maximum of 12 seconds to balance efficiency and security.
The system shall include secure authentication in the attendance record viewing process to ensure data integrity.
The system shall implement a fallback protocol to ensure reliability during peak loads.
The system shall utilize energy-efficient algorithms to minimize energy consumption during operations.
The system shall support energy-efficient cloud storage solutions for sustainable data management.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for a minimum of five years in compliance with regulations.
